header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
Through Mr. Shoukat Ali Rahimoon, advocate
Respondent The state through Mr. Neel Parkash, D.P.G.
body: Nisar Ahmed Bhanbhro, J: By means of the instant application, the applicant Faraz seeks post-arrest bail in crime No.134/2025 for offence under Section 24 of Sindh Arms Act, 2013, at P.S Khipro. Learned Trial Court vide order dated 16.07.2026 dismissed the bail plea of the applicant on the ground that he was involved in murder case registered vide FIR No 118/2025 at Police Station Khipro.

2. The facts and particulars of the prosecution case are already set out in the FIR, a copy whereof is annexed with the bail application; therefore, unnecessary reproduction thereof is avoided in view of the principle laid down in PLD 2014 SC 458.
3. Heard arguments and perused the material available on record.

4. This is an offshoot case of crime No.118/2025 of PS Khipro wherein the proceeding has already been stopped and the applicant/accused has already been granted bail in said crime. In such circumstances, the applicant/accused has made out a case for grant of bail in the case involving recovery of weapon. Therefore, the instant bail application is allowed, and the applicant/accused Faraz son of Atta Muhammad is admitted to post-arrest bail, subject to furnishing surety in the sum of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only), along with a P.R. bond in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.

5. Needless to mention here that the observations made hereinabove are tentative in nature and would not influence the learned Trial Court while deciding the case of the applicant on merits. JUDGE “Adnan Ashraf Nizamani”
